title: DPM-Solver: A Fast ODE Solver for Diffusion Probabilistic Model Sampling in Around 10 Steps
tldr_zh: 半线性结构：线性项解析、log-SNR 域泰勒展开网络项，1–3 阶指数积分器；10 NFE FID 4.70
tldr_en: Exploits semi-linear diffusion ODE: analytic linear part, Taylor expansion in log-SNR; order-1/2/3 exponential integrators reach FID 4.70 at 10 NFE.
key_numbers: CIFAR-10 FID 4.70 at 10 NFE, 2.87 at 20 NFE (Table 3)
DPM-Solver-2 FID 5.28 vs RK2(t) 16.40 at 12 NFE (Table 1)
Theorem 3.2: global error O(h_max^k) for k=1,2,3
